Es quien lidera técnicamente desde el kick-off y las etapas de definición hasta la puesta en producción, siendo el referente técnico de Iquall frente al cliente y el líder técnico interno para el equipo de delivery.

Principales Responsabilidades

Arquitectura y diseño técnico: Definir la arquitectura de la solución de automatización de red, adaptando el producto a los requerimientos técnicos reales del cliente. Establecer la estrategia de despliegue: etapas, dependencias, riesgos técnicos y criterios de aceptación.

Liderazgo técnico del delivery: Ser el referente técnico del equipo de implementación durante todo el ciclo del proyecto. Guiar y ordenar al equipo técnico para asegurar la coherencia de la solución y el cumplimiento de los objetivos.

Interacción técnica con el cliente: Ser el punto de contacto técnico principal frente a los equipos de ingeniería y operaciones del operador. Conducir sesiones técnicas de revisión, validación y cierre de cada etapa del proyecto.

Calidad y resultado técnico: Responsable del resultado técnico del proyecto: que la solución funcione, esté bien integrada, alineada a estándares como TM Forum y opere correctamente en producción.Colaborar con Product Management para trasladar aprendizajes del campo al producto.

Requisitos Excluyentes

  • Experiencia: 10+ años en roles técnicos en entornos de telecomunicaciones, con participación comprobable en proyectos de automatización, redes, integración de sistemas o despliegue de soluciones OSS/BSS en operadores reales.
  • Industria: Conocimiento profundo de redes de telecomunicaciones desde adentro: procesos de provisioning, gestión de configuración, monitoreo, operación de red. Experiencia trabajando con o dentro de operadores Tier-1.
  • Dominio técnico: Conocimiento práctico de protocolos y estándares del dominio: NETCONF, YANG, RESTCONF, SNMP, APIs TMForum o equivalentes.
  • Software: Comprensión de arquitecturas de integración, APIs REST y modelos de despliegue. Conocimientos de sistemas, procesos análisis y desarrollo de software.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería en Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Informática, Electrónica o Telecomunicaciones.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Competencias: Capacidad de liderazgo técnico, comunicación clara con perfiles de ingeniería exigentes, criterio para tomar decisiones bajo presión y orientación al resultado.

Deseable

  • Experiencia en empresas de software para telecom o integradores trabajando proyectos para operadores.
  • Certificaciones técnicas en la materia y/o conocimientos avanzados en productos referentes del mercado

Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol técnico de alto impacto con responsabilidad real sobre proyectos en redes de producción de operadores Tier-1.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización de vanguardia con tecnología propia.
  • Entorno técnicamente exigente, con foco en la calidad de la solución y el resultado del cliente.
  • Espacio para influir en la evolución del producto desde la experiencia del campo.

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment

Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Sênior - (Aromas)

Sobre Barentz

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. A empresa oferece ingredientes e especialidades dos principais fabricantes em todo o mundo, bem como suporte técnico de valor agregado, incluindo pré-mistura, mistura, formulação de ingredientes e testes de ingredientes em seus centros de formulação e laboratórios de aplicações de última geração na região EMEA, Américas e Ásia-Pacífico.

Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site: .

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que você precisa ter

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.

Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol
  • Adheres to protocol revisions and amendments as directed by the Regional Systems Engineering Manager
  • Assists in other tasks as needed by the Systems Engineering department
  • Provides training and guidance to Associates, Project Engineer I/II as needed.

Skills Required:

  • 10+ years experience in engineering development
  • 10+ years experience in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data and communications technologies
  • Good understanding of the J1939 and J1708 protocols and experience with Multiplex systems
  • Hardware design experience and ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience with hardware troubleshooting and lab equipment
  • Experience with network and protocol troubleshooting and tools
  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C and C++, SQL, VB, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, python, databases, report generation and networking
  • Ability to independently gather and document requirements and provide design requirements and product definition
  • Strong computer skills particularly with MS Office including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Masters Degree in related discipline.
  • Experience working with public transit is a plus

title: IT Support Analyst
description:
(We never request payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates through our official accounts and corporate platforms. If you are asked to make a payment, it is likely a scam. Please check to see if the position you are interested in is posted here on our website.)

TMF Group is a leading provider of administrative services, helping clients invest and operate securely around the world. As a global company with over 11,000 employees across more than 125 offices in 87 jurisdictions, we seek talented individuals with the potential to thrive at TMF Group, regardless of their background, and we offer career opportunities to the widest possible range of people. Once on board, we nurture and promote talented individuals, ensuring that leadership roles are within everyone’s reach.

Discover the Role

The role is dedicated to maintaining high-quality IT services and ensuring the efficient operation of users' devices and office technology. Collaboration with internal customers is essential to guarantee adherence to IT processes, maximize the benefit of technology solutions, and provide clear guidance regarding technological advancements.

The support team is expected to demonstrate organization, attention to detail, and a strong customer focus. Team members are responsible for supporting the global IT team by serving as local representatives for IT support and follow the best practices under ITSM framework.

Main Responsibilities

Provide expert-level user support, ensuring high availability, stability, and performance of IT services while acting as an escalation point for complex or high-impact issues.

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of end-user workplace (user and office devices) acting as a key interface with the global IT organization and external vendors.
  • Own and govern TMF’s IT asset management processes, ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement across inventory tracking and audits.
  • Manage and resolve complex incidents and service requests, applying strong root cause analysis and ensuring timely, high-quality resolutions aligned with SLA and KPI targets.
  • Coordinate escalations, follow-ups, and on-site support activities as required.
  • Oversee onboarding and offboarding technical activities, ensuring secure, standardized, and efficient device provisioning, recovery, and handover processes.
  • Contribute actively to local and global IT initiatives, including technology rollouts, process improvements, and automation efforts, providing technical leadership and local ownership.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and report security risks, threats, and vulnerabilities, reinforcing a strong security-first mindset and supporting compliance with corporate and regulatory standards.
  • Own the incident and service request queue, ensuring proper prioritization, workload balancing, SLA adherence, and continuous flow optimization across the support team.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and day-to-day guidance to junior and mid-level support engineers, fostering skills development and consistent service quality.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated proficiency with Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
  • Solid understanding of networking principles such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN setup.
  • Knowledgeable in managing user accounts and groups within Active Directory.
  • Highly organized and focused on delivering effective solutions balancing risk, urgency and quality.
  • Customer‑centric and service‑driven mindset showing empathy, ownership and professionalism.
  • Communicates confidently and clearly with stakeholders at all levels, translating technical concepts into understandable guidance and collaborating effectively within a multicultural, global IT organization.
  • Familiarity with ITSM framework.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.
  • Spanish will be considered as a plus.

Nossa presença global em mais de 80 países permite que você influencie a maneira como diversos clientes globais fazem negócios, bem como retribuir as comunidades globais em que operamos.

Seja parte do One TMF

Na TMF Group, nosso pessoal é o que nos torna quem somos. Nossa empresa prospera com o espírito empreendedor de pessoas proativas que combinam entusiasmo com responsabilidade e prestação de contas.

Um mundo de oportunidades

Independentemente de onde você esteja em sua carreira, a TMF Group abre um mundo de oportunidades onde você fará parte de nossa equipe e receberá suporte em sua jornada profissional.

title: Credit Risk Underwriter - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Credit Underwriting & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end underwriting process for the company’s credit products, ensuring applications are reviewed, analyzed, and documented according to internal credit policies.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of borrower information, credit bureau data, financial capacity, and behavioral indicators to support sound approve/reject decisions.
  • Prepare structured credit memos and recommendation reports for internal review and committee discussion.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and auditability across all underwriting decisions.

Credit Policy Implementation & Continuous Improvement

  • Translate credit policies and guidelines into practical underwriting workflows, checklists, and decision frameworks.
  • Support the implementation of new credit products from launch phase to scale, ensuring underwriting processes are robust, efficient, and aligned with risk appetite.
  • Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities in underwriting procedures and propose enhancements.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and provide feedback loops to refine credit criteria, eligibility rules, and approval standards.

Portfolio Analytics & Credit Policy Interpretation

  • Interpret the portfolio analytics outputs produced by the Data AVP (vintage analysis, PD/LGD back testing, score migration matrices) and translate them into actionable credit policy adjustment proposals: cutoff recalibration, rate tier shifts, eligibility criteria refinements.
  • Prepare quarterly portfolio review packages for the credit committee, including performance summaries, model monitoring metrics, and recommended policy actions with supporting analysis.
  • Monitor portfolio concentration risk, sector exposure, and early warning indicators on an ongoing basis. Escalate emerging risks and propose mitigation actions to Credit Risk AVP.

Portfolio Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track key credit performance indicators, including approval rates, delinquency trends, and early warning signals.
  • Prepare recurring portfolio analysis and performance reports for internal stakeholders and credit committees.
  • Escalate emerging risks and recommend corrective actions when needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Risk, Data, Operations, and Business teams to ensure smooth execution of credit processes.
  • Support documentation and governance standards related to underwriting and credit decisioning.
  • Contribute to building the company’s credit knowledge base as new products and processes are developed.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3–6 years of experience in credit underwriting, credit policy, or credit risk analysis within a fintech, finance company, SCD, or bank.
  • Proven hands-on experience leading underwriting processes for a structured credit product. Experience with secured lending / regulated lending products is a strong plus.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Network and Systems Administrator
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and

Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to grow your career in IT Infrastructure?

We’re looking for a hands‑on, motivated Network & Systems Administrator to support our growing IT environment in Brazil. This is a great opportunity for someone with solid experience who wants to deepen their technical skills, work with modern technologies, and be part of a global, collaborative team.

Job Description

Your Mission: You Will…

  • Support day‑to‑day operations of corporate networks, servers, and IT systems.
  • Configure and maintain LAN, WAN, VPN, and Wi‑Fi networks across offices and datacenters.
  • Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot hardware, software, and infrastructure components.
  • Investigate and resolve IT incidents reported by users, ensuring reliable service delivery.
  • Follow corporate security policies and contribute to maintaining a safe and compliant environment.
  • Assist in IT infrastructure projects, documentation, upgrades, and system improvements.
  • Collaborate with your Team Lead, peers, cross‑functional teams, and external vendors when needed.

Qualifications

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related discipline is desirable but not essential.
  • Proven experience in network/system administration in a corporate environment.
  • Practical knowledge of routing, switching, Wi‑Fi networks and firewalls.
  • Experience with VPN solutions or ZTNA.
  • VMware or alternative vendor virtualisation experience.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) – networking/security fundamentals are enough.
  • Good understanding of DNS, user/role‑based access control, and general IT security practices.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and communicate clearly with global teams.
  • You are fluent in English (written and spoken).

You’ll Stand Out If You Have…

  • Certifications such as Cisco/Juniper, Linux Admin, VMware, or Windows Admin.
  • Hands‑on experience with Meraki devices and Wi‑Fi controllers.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • A proactive, solution‑oriented mindset and willingness to continuously learn.
  • Experience working in a distributed or multinational environment.

Thrive in a Culture That Values…

  • Learning opportunities and support to grow into more advanced responsibilities.
  • A friendly, collaborative team that shares knowledge and works together across regions.
  • A stable environment where you can build long‑term technical expertise.
  • Flexibility, ownership, and trust in managing your work.
  • A respectful and inclusive workplace where your contribution truly matters.

Additional Information

HOW TO APPLY?

Along with your CV, please submit a short motivation letter outlining your experience in network and systems administration or related IT roles. You can add this directly in the “Message to the Hiring Manager” section when applying.

IT INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

You’ll be joining a supportive and experienced team responsible for keeping Playtech’s core systems running smoothly. We work with a variety of technologies, collaborate globally, and value teamwork, reliability, and continuous improvement. It’s a great environment to grow your skills while working on meaningful technical challenges.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome everyone and celebrate diversity across our teams.

title: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat is hiring: Structural Engineer | Fully Remote | English Speaking

Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting a Structural Engineer to join a US-based partner company.

In this role, you will work remotely performing structural analysis and design for projects including awnings and similar outdoor structures. This is an ideal position for an experienced engineer looking for flexible, project-based work with the potential to grow into a full-time role.

Key Responsibilities:

* Structural Analysis: perform detailed structural calculations and analysis for outdoor structures such as awnings.

* Design & Documentation: prepare structural drawings, specifications, and technical reports that meet international standards and client requirements.

* Software Modeling: use structural analysis software (SAP2000 or equivalent) to model loads, stresses, and structural behavior.

* Technical Collaboration: coordinate with architects, fabricators, and project managers to ensure structural integrity and constructability of designs.

* Quality Assurance: review designs for compliance with applicable building codes and engineering best practices.

Requirements:

* 3-5 years of experience in structural engineering, preferably with exposure to steel, aluminum, or lightweight structures.

* Advanced/Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.

* Proficiency with structural analysis software such as SAP2000.

title: Senior Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior backend Developer - Java

You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location. It is necessary to live in the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience of the technologies Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.

  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.

HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:

  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs

  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself

Atuar junto às lideranças na gestão de conflitos, clima, engajamento, desenvolvimento de times e mitigação de riscos trabalhistas.

  • Inglês ao nível avançado, com habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, é desejável;

title: HR Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.

Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;

Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;

Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);

Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;

Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances;

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);

Life Insurance;

Annual Bonus;

Private Pension Plan;

Childcare Allowance.

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Service Desk Specialist
description:
Servicedesk SME - English & French/German/Spanish

Brazil (Sao Paulo) - Onsite

Fulltime

Primary Work Environment

This position will be a resource for level 1 and level 2 support analysts to resolve problems requiring a greater level of technical expertise and/or time. Level 3 support analysts can expect to spend most of their time researching and resolving technical problems/issues and may be required to work as primary Level 1/2 staff if shorthanded. Technical information training and dissemination to global service desk staff is key for this role. Responsibility for creating, updating, and reviewing Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents is a normal daily activity. There may be large/small project involvement when Solutions Center resources are needed, or information needs to be disseminated to Solutions Center staff globally. This position will require frequent interaction between Solutions Center staff, other IT groups, and management. Travel to other sites to address end user issues may be required.

Responsibilities

  1. Internal service desk escalator for issues requiring more extensive troubleshooting, investigation, or time for resolution.
  2. Advanced end user technical resolution on items such as PC hardware and software issues; software installations and upgrades.
  3. Provide advanced support duties for applications, network, server, and security functions where interaction is required with the appropriate IT functional teams all in support of addressing end user issues. This generally coincides with advanced privileges in various areas.
  4. Support for labs, special builds, VIPs, and emergency support on a scheduled or ad hoc basis; often at the request of the Solutions Center Manager / Team Lead (as needed).
  5. Population and maintenance of Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents.
  6. Proactive recognition and resolution of end user and IT support issues to maintain a high level of visibility within the end user community.
  7. Participate in projects and incident reviews that will enhance the quality of the Solutions Center service level and promote technical and career growth.
  8. Participate in interview process for level 1 and 2 support analysts in region (where applicable).
  9. Train all new regional Solutions Center and support staff.
  10. Coach, mentor and educate level 1 and level 2 support analysts on critical thinking, end user experience and technical skills to solve end user issues.
  11. Perform data center support tasks supporting follow the sun model (where applicable).
  12. Fill in for primary level 1 and 2 solutions center tasks when needed based on volume, staffing or emergency.

description:

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.

Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!

Our Culture

At respond.io , we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!

Role Description

At Respond.io , Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions
  • Empower customers to self-serve and help users navigate our on-demand success resources
  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company
  • Experience in at least one of the following : API integrations, WhatsApp API, or Agentic AI
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, and the proven ability to understand customer’s inquiries
  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges

Here's What's In For You

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.

The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.

We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.

What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.

2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.

Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.

2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows

Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.

A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais , por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.

O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Brazil Service Representative
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Brazil Service Representative (Manager Level) to lead and execute product and service operations across the Brazilian market. This role covers end-to-end service management, including offline customer service, technical support, repair network development, and distributor management, with the goal of enhancing customer satisfaction and service excellence in Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning and execution of product and service operations in Brazil, including offline customer service, technical support, repair services, and distributor management.
  • Establish and manage a local repair service network, including onboarding, supervising, and evaluating authorized service centers.
  • Develop service standards and SOPs, monitor repair quality and turnaround time, and ensure compliance with company quality standards.
  • Oversee offline customer service and technical support activities, including handling customer inquiries, resolving technical issues, providing product training, and managing escalations or complex cases.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with HQ CED team, Supply Chain, and Sales to ensure timely service resource allocation and issue resolution.
  • Ensure local service operations comply with Brazilian regulations, including consumer protection laws, product safety certification, and data privacy requirements. Establish risk monitoring mechanisms where necessary.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related fields.
  • Proven experience in regional service, after-sales service, or customer service management
  • Experience in the consumer electronics industry is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience building a local service network from scratch (0–1 setup) is a strong plus.
  • Native or fluent Portuguese and Mandarin (mandatory).
  • Proficient in English as a working language, able to communicate effectively with HQ teams.

title: Analista de risco de crédito
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos buscando uma pessoa com perfil quantitativo para atuar na área centralizada de Monitoramento de Risco de Crédito do Banco Cooperativo Sicredi, responsável por apoiar a gestão de risco de crédito de um sistema com mais de 100 cooperativas.

Nosso time tem papel crítico na sustentação do ciclo risco → provisão (IFRS 9 / Res. CMN 4.966) → resultado, traduzindo dados e modelos em diagnósticos executivos, insumos para decisões de negócio e direcionamentos.

A posição terá destaque por assumir a esteira de projeções de carteira e provisão, apoiar o orçamento e o stress testing, além de atuar como referência técnica em análises de sensibilidade e estudos quantitativos robustos que conectam risco, rentabilidade e governança.

É uma oportunidade para trabalhar em temas estratégicos, com alta visibilidade, forte interação com áreas de risco, crédito, finanças e com a rede de cooperativas, e com espaço real para construir e elevar o padrão técnico das análises e dos processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir as rotinas de projeções de carteira, provisão e indicadores de risco, garantindo consistência com bases oficiais e premissas aprovadas;
  • Estruturar e executar análises de sensibilidadee cenários (base/estressado/mitigado), traduzindo impactos em provisão e resultado;
  • Desenvolver e manter modelos e artefatos de projeção e simulação (ex.: ECL, migração, vintage, transição de atraso/estágios, comportamento de carteira);
  • Apoiar o ciclo de orçamento do banco e insumos para cooperativas/centrais, conectando premissas de risco e projeções financeiras;
  • Planejar e operacionalizar exercícios de teste de estresse (cenários e simulações), em articulação com as frentes de RAS/ICAAP e governança interna;
  • Evoluir análises de segmentação/clusters e suas bases, suportando leitura por perfil de cooperativa e direcionamento de ações;
  • Produzir materiais executivos e análises para comitês e agendas de gestão (prévia, fechamento, reports gerenciais), com narrativa clara e acionável;
  • Garantir governança técnica dos números (reprodutibilidade, rastreabilidade, documentação, versionamento e controles);
  • Atuar como referência quantitativa do time, apoiando pares em discussões metodológicas, qualidade de dados e melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Interagir com áreas parceiras (modelagem, crédito, produtos, finanças, centrais/cooperativas) para alinhar premissas, interpretar resultados e propor caminhos de ação.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior completa em Estatística, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Ciência de Dados, Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prática em análises quantitativas aplicadas a crédito/risco/finanças (modelagem, projeções, simulações, sensibilidade);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise (mínimo: SQL e/ou Python/R, além de Excel avançado; capacidade de automatizar rotinas);
  • Capacidade de estruturar análises end-to-end: definir premissas, tratar dados, modelar, validar e comunicar resultados;
  • Organização e rigor para trabalhar com números oficiais: controle de versões, rastreabilidade e documentação;
  • Comunicação clara para traduzir análises complexas em mensagens objetivas para público não técnico.

Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais)

  • Experiência com IFRS 9 / ECL e/ou Res. CMN 4.966 (staging, drivers de provisão, PD/LGD/EAD, overlays);
  • Vivência com stress testing, cenários macro, ICAAP/RAS, ou frameworks semelhantes de gestão de risco;
  • Experiência com Power BI (modelagem de dados, DAX, governança de relatórios) e integração com pipelines de dados;
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de segmentação/clustering e análise de portfólio por perfis (ex.: clusters de cooperativas);
  • Experiência em instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito ou consultorias de risco, com interação com áreas de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de engenharia analítica (ex.: Git, ambientes, testes, pipelines, reprodutibilidade).

Informações adicionais

No Centro Administrativo Sicredi (CAS) para as posições nas áreas de negócio adotamos o formato de trabalho híbrido que se consolidou em 3 dias presenciais, na Sede da empresa, localizada na Av. Assis Brasil, 3940, São Sebastião, Porto Alegre/RS e 2 dias em teletrabalho. Nas posições da área Tech adotamos o formato de teletrabalho

No Sicredi você vai ter:

14º e 15º salários fixos;

Participações nos Resultados (conforme a senioridade);

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico sem coparticipação,

Programas de bem-estar com Wellhub (antiga Gympass), Nutrição, Psicologia, Laboral, Massagem, Grupo de corrida e academia local;

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição – com flexibilidade de % nos cartões VA/VR, sem coparticipação;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Auxílio creche ou babá para crianças até 6 anos e 11 meses;

Auxílio para filhos com deficiência, sem limite de idade;

Seguro de vida,

Previdência Privada até 8% do salário;

Plataforma de Treinamentos – Sicredi Aprende, com diversos cursos;

Carga horária de 40h semanais – Utilizando sistema de banco de horas;

title: Senior AI Developer
description:
Senior AI Developer

Brazil

Senior AI Specialist

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Senior AI Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient software applications. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design the interaction flow between different AI Agents (e.g., Diagnostic Agent triggers Optimization Agent);
  • Code the decision-making logic that interprets real-time data streams and triggers specific AI interventions;
  • Deploy and manage Gradient Boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM) and Neural Network models within Azure;
  • Utilize Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI / Prompt Flow to build conversational or reasoning capabilities for the advisor;
  • Orchestrate the interaction between physics-based models residing in Synapse and the AI layer;
  • Implement MLOps practices for model versioning, retraining, and drift detection;
  • Design and optimize system prompts for LLM-based components of the advisor;
  • Optimize inference latency to ensure real-time recommendations (sub-second response);
  • Expose AI capabilities via secure REST APIs for consumption by the UI/BI layer;
  • Ensure AI models comply with data privacy and security standards.

Essential Skills

  • Strong experience developing AI or machine learning solutions using Python;
  • Advanced knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Scikit learn;
  • Experience deploying and managing machine learning models including Gradient Boosting models such as XGBoost or LightGBM;
  • Hands on experience with Azure AI services such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service or Azure Machine Learning;
  • Experience working with data platforms such as Azure Synapse Analytics or Spark;
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel or AutoGen;
  • Experience implementing MLOps practices including model versioning, retraining and monitoring;
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes;
  • Experience developing and exposing REST APIs to integrate AI capabilities into applications;
  • Strong problem solving skills and ability to optimize AI model performance and inference latency.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.

Required Skills & Experience

• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).

Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Quality Manager
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

  • 20+ R&D and operations centers
  • 50+ manufacturing bases
  • 80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally
  • 10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity
  • Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms
  • Over 50% international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

1. Development of the Quality Management System (QMS):

Develop, implement, and maintain a robust QMS for the project.

Define quality standards, procedures, and guidelines aligned with project requirements and organizational goals.

2. Quality Planning:

Collaborate with the Project Manager to develop quality plans for each phase of the project.

Establish key quality management performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and monitor project quality.

3. Quality Assurance:

Conduct regular quality assurance audits to ensure compliance with established standards and procedures.

Identify areas for improvement and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Documentation and Reporting:

Maintain accurate and comprehensive documentation of all quality-related activities.

Prepare regular reports on quality performance and present results to project stakeholders.

5. Training and Awareness:

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now SaaS products.

We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.

We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.

You Are

An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.

You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and SaaS-oriented design work.

Role Description

This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.

You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing SaaS initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.

Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.

Responsibilities
  • Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
  • Support video and social content with strong visual design
  • Contribute to UX/UI design for SaaS and internal software products
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
  • Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
  • Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
  • Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction
Qualifications
  • Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
  • Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
  • Attention to detail and strong design judgment
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  • Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request
